nodes.title: Canvas — 0.2 MP starter; raise after first render
MacMax - READ ME FIRST
widgets_values:
# MacMax · Parasyte video + audio

**First run**
1. Install the node packs and five model files (SETUP below).
2. Select your files in column 3, including Parasyte.
3. Edit the demo prompt in column 2, then click Run.
4. Your video with stereo audio appears in column 4.

**Parasyte is ON and fully wired.** Eight steps,
ER-SDE / beta57; shift 12 / 3; strength 1.5.
Leave the compatibility node on strip.

**Starter canvas:** 0.2 MP, 5 seconds. Increase resolution
after the first successful render; it costs time and memory.
Five seconds rounds to 124 frames (5.17s at 24 fps).

**Image modes:** both images off = T2V; first on = I2V;
both on = first/last frame. Select your images first.
Use the node menu's Bypass action. Purple means off.

Chaining and extra exports start OFF.
Do not use EasyCache or Spectrum with Parasyte: visible artifacts.
The optional int8 base path has separate settings below.
Historical tests used 48 GB; smaller Macs need testing.

**Measured wall time (48 GB M5 Pro):**
- 0.2 MP, 5s / 8 steps: **6m 54s**.
- 0.4 MP, 5s / 8 steps: **12m 52s**.
Single runs, including load/decode/save. See README for test conditions.

nodes.title: SETUP - models & custom nodes
widgets_values:
## Setup for the default Parasyte path

Run `./install_node_packs.sh` with ComfyUI stopped, then restart.
Default packs: ComfyUI-GGUF, PlagueKind Nodes, comfyui-obvpm,
and AppleSilicon-FP8 (for the optional int8 path).
`extras` adds Motion Context and ClipProj. `all` installs both sets.

Download these five files (~37 GB total) into `ComfyUI/models/`:

**diffusion_models/**
[MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-Pruned-Q5_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/Abiray/MiniMax-H3-Pruned-GGUF/resolve/main/MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-Pruned-Q5_K_M.gguf)

**loras/**
[H3-PK-Parasyte-Turbo.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Plaguekind/H3-Lora/resolve/main/H3-PK-Parasyte-Turbo.safetensors)

**text_encoders/**
[qwen3vl-32B-MiniMax-H3-Q4_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/realrebelai/MiniMax-H3_GGUFs/resolve/main/qwen3vl-32B-MiniMax-H3-Q4_K_M.gguf)

**vae/**
[minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
[minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

Select your actual filenames in each loader if they live in subfolders.
Use GGUF for the text encoder, not the CUDA-only NVFP4-AWQ file.

Start ComfyUI from its activated venv:
```
ASFP8_INT8_EXT=1 python main.py --port 8288 \
  --reserve-vram 10 --cache-none --disable-smart-memory
```
The local test stack is ComfyUI 0.34.0, frontend 1.51.9, torch 2.13.0 on MPS.
Do not apply old 0.30.0 cherry-pick instructions to this newer installation.

nodes.title: PROMPTING - read before your first render
widgets_values:
## Demo prompt and audio

The PROMPT node contains the kitchen-to-camera demo in prompt_vertical.txt.
It uses real paragraphs, one continuous take and explicit dialogue.

The 15-word line is brisk for five seconds. Use the default as a timing test;
check whether the entire line is spoken before extending duration, which costs memory.
Historical car-scene benchmarks used a different prompt and are not this demo's timings.

For your own clips, describe subject, scene, camera, sound and any dialogue.
Keep spoken words explicit. Avoid numbered shots for a continuous take.

Duration rounds up to H3's frame grid: 5 seconds produces 124 frames (5.17s at 24 fps).
Two-step smoke tests check execution only; they cannot establish speech quality.

Demo prompt — edit here
widgets_values:
Vertical smartphone-style portrait video, 28mm front camera look, soft late-afternoon window light from the left, natural skin texture, slight handheld drift, fine grain, no lettering anywhere in frame.

Scene overview: A woman in her late twenties stands in a bright home kitchen talking straight to camera, casual and warm, like a phone recording.

Storyboard:
[0s-5s] One continuous take: Vertical medium close-up, head and shoulders filling the upper two thirds of the frame, kitchen counter and a window softly out of focus behind her. She looks into the lens and speaks, one small nod, natural blink.

Camera: Static Shot held at chest height, very slight handheld drift.

Audio: her voice, close and clear with a natural American accent, faint room tone and a distant street hum underneath. She says: "This whole clip came out of a laptop. Picture and sound, one pass, no studio."

Music: none

No text, subtitles, lettering, signage, logos or watermarks of any kind.

widgets_values:
## CHAINING (Motion Context) + LOW-RAM TEXT ENCODER

**Chain clips (motion + audio continue across the cut).** Needs
[ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context](https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context).
All four nodes here ship BYPASSED. Before rendering a clip you may want to continue,
un-bypass Save Latent (~7 MB per clip under output/h3_context/) - a clip rendered without
it cannot be continued later. To CONTINUE a clip: un-bypass Motion Context, Trim and
Load Latent as well, set Load Latent clip_index to the clip you continue FROM and Save
Latent clip_index to the clip this one IS. Bypass both image inputs for continuations,
and use a new h3_context folder for each separate chain. Then queue. The continuation comes back exactly 22
frames shorter (the pinned context, trimmed for clean concat). Validated on a 48GB M5:
5s + 5s join r=0.95, the audio bed continues (small level swell). Resolution must match
between chained clips. Motion Context refuses to run without a context latent wired.

**Low-RAM text encoder (optional).** The bypassed ClipProj Loader swaps the 13.6 GB 32B
GGUF encoder for Qwen3-VL-8B fp8 (+380 MB projection) ~= 3.7 GB lighter in the historical comparison. Memory savings depend on the configuration. Needs
[ComfyUI-ClipProj](https://github.com/nicolab28/ComfyUI-ClipProj) + matrices from
HF NicoLab28/ClipProj-MiniMax-H3. To use: un-bypass and wire its CLIP output in place of
the GGUF loader, then bypass the GGUF loader. Select the installed encoder and projection
filenames in their dropdowns. Seed-matched A/B vs GGUF: identity, wardrobe and spoken lines held;
speed unchanged. Prompt-sensitive edge cases exist (proper nouns) - eyeball outputs.

## Optional int8 base path (20 steps)

The default is now Parasyte on GGUF. This older int8 loader is OFF and disconnected.
Only use it if you have the matching pruned FL2VA int8 checkpoint installed.

1. Select the int8 checkpoint and enable this loader.
2. Connect its MODEL output to Sigma shift's model input, replacing the compatibility cable.
3. Bypass GGUF DiT, Parasyte and compatibility in column 3.
4. Set 20 steps, Euler / Simple, sigma shift 6 / 3. Do not use EasyCache or Spectrum with turbo LoRAs.

**Return to Parasyte:** reconnect compatibility MODEL → Sigma shift model;
enable GGUF, Parasyte and compatibility, bypass this int8 loader.
Restore 8 steps, ER-SDE / beta57, shift 12 / 3, strength 1.5, compatibility strip.

**GGUF without LoRA:** leave GGUF and compatibility enabled, bypass Parasyte;
set the base sampling settings above. The strip fix is harmless without a LoRA.

Never feed Parasyte from this int8 loader. The release's turbo path was tested on GGUF.

[Optional int8 checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
[Parasyte model card](https://huggingface.co/Plaguekind/H3-Lora)
